_comment: Where each annotation effort's raw annotation files come from. Efforts not listed here keep their raw annotations tracked in this repo, under <effort>/annotations/, so a single pull gives code and annotations at one consistent version. The efforts below carry their own git history and remote and are cloned separately; after cloning this repo, clone each into the path shown and check it is not behind its remote before running MAKE.R.

external_repos.note: Active annotation repo with real history. combine.R reads its annotations/ subtree.
Public-release bundle (annotations + example audio), gigabytes; distributed outside this repo.

not_reproducible_from_clone.reason: combine.R reads data/02_auto_beehive.csv and data/02_auto_night.csv, machine-generated detection candidates (~5.6 MB) that live under the ignored data/ and are not tracked anywhere. Machine-labeled training ballast, never scored.
